title: Synthesis of the deployment (synthesis.yaml) v0.3.0
description: Per actor, under the id of its cell: the synthesis sources and the synthesis per row of the assessment and of each act (RFC-047). The deployment keeps them until the migration of RFC-045 moves them into the consumer's regulation. The shapes are those of process.json, whose definitions this schema reuses.

synthesis.description: Lexostatuses from cells that the process merges (see process.json, synthesis).

assessment_rows.description: Per-row synthesis of the assessment before submitting.

action_rows.description: Per act, by the name of its event: its per-row synthesis.
